thesis: The episode introduces Mark Johnson, the managing partner of Astra Capital Management, and outlines his career path from investment banking at Merrill Lynch to private equity at firms like Blackstone and Carlisle. The conversation explores his early experiences with leverage, his planned life trajectory, and his transition into founding a mid-market growth buyout firm focused on communications and technology services.
